title: The true pardon item ('signed at Marrowgate, forty years late — read it where the Company can hear it') stays in inventory with that same instruction text even after the only place it could ever be read (the Gallows Glade) is permanently destroyed by fire. The item never updates to reflect that its stated purpose is now impossible, which could make a player think they still have an outstanding way to use it.
where: inventory item 'the true pardon, unsent' after burning The Gallows Glade
